sql_query:
SELECT AVG(ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(rv.review_creation_date AS timestamp) - CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS timestamp))) / 86400.0))::numeric AS average_days_to_review
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews rv ON o.order_id = rv.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND rv.review_creation_date IS NOT NULL;
